correctness.rationale: For every valuation ∆p at v is the homogeneity indicator for R(v). These indicators coincide precisely for identical nontrivial successor sets or two sets of size at most one, yielding the homogeneous-type equivalence. Partition all n worlds into at most n+1 type classes, with largest class size M and k nonfunctional types; then Mk≤M(n−M+1)≤(n+1)^2/4. Encodings and functional rows cost at most (n+1)^{3n}. A prescribed empty-row A and independently A-targeting B give 2^{(floor(n/2)−2)ceil(n/2)} distinct satisfying relations. The upper/lower logarithms have a common n²/4 leading term. Exhaustive Boolean modal semantics and type criterion agree on every labelled relation through n=4 (2,10,128,3070 accepting); independent family tests through n=11 pass. No infinite result is inferred from finite tests.
